topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I just found out that my neighbor, Bill, has been living like a regular Joe all these years, but he’s actually swimming in money. I mean, who does that? I’ve seen him every morning, sipping his cheap coffee from the corner store, always friendly, always waving. And now I find out his house is practically a museum of rare art and he’s got stocks and investments I couldn’t even dream of. I keep thinking, why didn’t he ever show off? Was I not good enough to know? It’s driving me crazy, wondering what else I don’t know, what else I’m missing out on. I guess some people just like to play their cards close to their chest, but it doesn’t make it any easier to digest.
